coordinate_convention: Native1920x1080 visible whole-animal xyxy, excluding shadows; partial border/occluded animals retained; no amodal extent inferred.
uncertainty_policy: All boxes retained for conservative full-visible metrics. Also report definite-only sensitivity, separately separating withheld-principal animals and nuisance fragments; uncertain means presence and/or extent cannot be firmly established under truncation, occlusion or blur.

second_review.findings: Retain ambiguous trailing fragments as uncertain; include stationary6110 upper-left fragment as uncertain nuisance; principal6102 sequence reasonable. No predicted detections or recognition used.

provenance.publisher_annotation_reuse: Publisher COCO files have torso masks/keypoints for only4/9 query cows and no trustworthy source-frame mapping; filename12 is dataset_id, not frame number. No automatic truth transfer.
